**Download the speech model right in the app.** No Terminal needed any more: on first launch, the Set Up Tsuzuri window has a **Download** button for the speech model. No license changes; no breaking changes (models you already downloaded keep working).

## In-app model download

- The **Set Up Tsuzuri** window now has a **Speech Model** row next to Microphone and Accessibility: **Download (1.6 GB)**, a progress bar with bytes and percent, **Cancel**, and **Try Again** after an error. When the download finishes the row turns green and the model loads by itself.
- The **Model** menu lists models you haven't downloaded as **Download (size)…**; click one to download it and switch to it. While it downloads, the menu item and the first menu line show the progress.
- Pressing the shortcut before a model is installed says "Download the speech model first" and opens the setup window. The first menu line reads "Speech model not downloaded · Click to Download".
- Downloads resume where they stopped after Cancel, a lost connection or quitting the app.
- Files are first saved to a staging folder (`Models/.downloads`) and checked against fixed checksums (SHA-256 for the weights) pinned to an exact Hugging Face revision. Only when every file is verified does the model folder appear, so a half-finished download is never mistaken for an installed model.
- Clear messages for no internet connection, not enough disk space (checked before starting), a damaged download and server errors.
- The Silero VAD silence detector is downloaded together with the first model.
- If the chosen model is missing but another one is installed, Tsuzuri uses that one instead of asking for a download.
- Behind a firewall or where Hugging Face is slow, point downloads at a mirror: `defaults write com.kanaworks.tsuzuri hfEndpoint https://hf-mirror.com` (`HF_ENDPOINT` for the command line).
- New text is translated into all 30 interface languages.

## Dictation

- No more overlay text after a successful paste: the text already appears where your cursor is. Before, apps that don't report the focused field (such as Chrome) showed a "copied" notice with the whole text every time. The text still stays on the clipboard and in Recent when Tsuzuri can't tell where it went; the notice now only appears when nothing editable has focus and the text was only copied.

## Privacy

- Downloading a model is the only thing in Tsuzuri that uses the internet, and it only happens when you click **Download**. Recording, recognition and Polish still run entirely on your Mac; audio is never sent anywhere.

## Command line

- `tsuzuri-cli --download [--model NAME]` downloads a model (and Silero VAD) the same way the app does, with resume and checksum verification.

## Not changed

- Polish (spokenly/cleanup-1) still has to be converted once in Terminal (see the README): there is no ready-made MLX version to download yet.

## Docs

- README (English, Japanese, Chinese): installation is now "open the app → click Download"; the Terminal commands remain as an alternative.
